audience: Spanish freelancers and small businesses that issue invoices in TS Facturas

useCases.title: Chase unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List the issued invoices filtered by paid state. Open one invoice to see its lines, taxes, totals and contact.

useCases.title: Review payments received and made
useCases.text: List payments by direction, method or date range. Check the contact or account of each payment.

useCases.title: Review expenses by supplier
useCases.text: List the expenses of a period with their identifier, date and totals. Filter them by supplier VAT number.

useCases.title: Add a new customer to the books
useCases.text: Search the contacts by VAT number first. Then create the customer or provider with its VAT number and email.

useCases.title: Record a payment received
useCases.text: Record income received or an expense paid in the books. Link the payment to one contact or one document.
